title: Linking/Approach Parameter Catalog — Per-Cycle Linking Options ~960 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas for per-cycle linking and approach/retract parameters. Every cycle type has 6-10 linking parameters (lead_in_type arc/line/helix, lead_in_radius, lead_in_angle, lead_out_type, retract_policy, transition_type, stay_down, keepdown, entry_method) that control tool motion between cutting passes. These parameters have major impact on cycle time and tool life. ~960 schemas covering all 120+ cycle types.

reference: hyperMILL training manuals (linking, approach/retract sections per cycle category)

forge_triple.hook: linkingApproachSafetyValidator — BUILT — validates approach speed and retract clearance
forge_triple.action: generate_linking_catalog — BUILT — generates linking domain artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-linking-params — BUILT — linking parameter reference with cycle time optimization

sessions.title: Lead-In/Out + Retract Policy Schemas (~500 params)
knowledge: Lead-in types: arc, line, helix, tangential, ramp, plunge
Lead-out types: arc, line, tangential, retract-to-clearance
Retract policies: to clearance, to retract height, minimal retract, no retract (stay down)
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for lead-in/lead-out parameters and retract policy parameters across all cycle types. Lead-in arc radius validation against tool radius. Helix lead-in angle limits. Retract clearance validation against clearance plane.

units.title: Lead-In/Lead-Out Parameter Schemas — ~320 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for lead-in parameters (lead_in_type arc/line/helix/tangential/ramp/plunge, lead_in_radius, lead_in_angle, lead_in_length, lead_in_overlap) and lead-out parameters (lead_out_type arc/line/tangential/retract, lead_out_radius, lead_out_angle, lead_out_length) across all ~80 cycle types that support linking. Arc lead-in radius must be >= tool radius. Helix angle must be within ramp angle limits.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Lead-in schemas: >= 200 parameters across 80+ cycle types
Lead-out schemas: >= 120 parameters across 80+ cycle types
Arc radius validation hook: lead_in_radius >= tool_radius
Helix angle hook: validates against ramp angle limits from Metric.cfg
Unit tests for arc lead-in radius validation and helix angle range

units.title: Retract Policy + Transition Schemas — ~180 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for retract policy parameters (retract_type to_clearance/to_retract/minimal/none, retract_height, retract_feed, rapid_retract_flag) and transition parameters (transition_type direct/arc/via_clearance, transition_speed, gap_handling keep_contact/retract/skip) across all cycle types. Stay-down optimization hook identifies unnecessary retracts that waste cycle time.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Retract policy schemas: >= 120 parameters across cycle types
Transition schemas: >= 60 parameters with gap handling logic
Stay-down optimization hook flags unnecessary retracts
Unit tests for retract height vs clearance plane consistency

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 480 lead-in/out + retract schemas | ✓ arc radius + helix angle + stay-down hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Entry/Stay-Down/KeepDown + Linking Artifact Batch Generation (~460 params + artifacts)
knowledge: Entry method parameters: ramp, helix, plunge, pre-drill
Stay-down / keepdown strategies per cycle type
Linking parameter impact on cycle time (30-50% of non-cutting time)
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for entry method, stay-down, and keepdown parameters. Then batch-generate all linking domain artifacts. Entry method validation links to tool capability (e.g., center-cutting required for plunge). Cycle time impact estimation for linking choices.

units.title: Entry Method + Stay-Down + KeepDown Schemas — ~460 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for entry method parameters (entry_method ramp/helix/plunge/pre-drill, ramp_angle, helix_diameter, plunge_feed, pre_drill_depth), stay-down parameters (stay_down_enabled, max_stay_down_distance, gap_threshold, minimum_cut_length), and keepdown parameters (keepdown_mode, keepdown_height, keepdown_clearance) across all cycle types. Entry method hook validates center-cutting capability for plunge entry. Cycle time estimator computes non-cutting time based on linking choices.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Entry method schemas: >= 200 parameters across all cycle types
Stay-down schemas: >= 160 parameters with gap threshold logic
KeepDown schemas: >= 100 parameters with height validation
Entry method hook validates center-cutting for plunge entry via ToolRegistry
Cycle time impact estimator quantifies linking time reduction from stay-down

units.title: Linking Domain Artifact Batch Generation — ~960 skills + scripts + hooks
units.description: Artifact generation for the entire linking domain. Reads all ~960 parameter schemas and auto-generates skill templates with cycle time optimization guidance, AC Python setter scripts, and hook validation rules. Registers arc radius, helix angle, stay-down, center-cutting, and retract safety hooks.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Skill templates generated for all ~960 linking parameters
AC Python setter scripts generated for all ~960 parameters
>= 6 safety hooks registered for linking domain
tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors on all generated artifacts

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 940 total linking schemas | ✓ ~960 skills + scripts | ✓ >= 6 hooks | ✓ cycle time estimator | omega_floor >= 0.90
